title: Auditing ImageNet: Towards a Model-driven Framework for Annotating Demographic Attributes of Large-Scale Image Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying demographic biases (age, gender, race) in the ImageNet dataset. These biases are framed as 'undesirable' and 'not aligned with values of society,' directly engaging with ethical concerns around fairness, representation, and the societal impact of AI models trained on such data.
